svg.title: A projected validation accepts Riju's configuration while Cecil preserves its warning.
svg.desc: A bar reserved for the deterministic PREVIEW label covers nearly all of a red unresolved column. The clinic, welfare, rail, market and school nodes remain dark. Riju lowers his hand while Cecil stamps a separate warning record: the configuration is valid, but nothing is live.
